data.assumption: I interpreted “how much of our business is online” as the share of non-test order value from orders whose channel is 'online', calculated separately per currency to avoid mixing minor units.
data.sql: SELECT currency, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(channel) = 'online' THEN total_minor ELSE 0 END) AS DECIMAL(38, 6)) / NULLIF(SUM(total_minor), 0) AS value FROM orders WHERE is_test = false GROUP BY currency
